instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
2. Rest a barbell across your thighs, just above your knees, and hold it steady.
3. Press through the balls of your feet and lift your heels as high as possible.
4. Squeeze your calves at the top.
5. Lower your heels back down with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Hold the barbell firmly against your thighs so it does not shift.
2. Pause and squeeze hard at the top for full calf contraction.
3. Lower slowly through a full range of motion.
4. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor.
2. Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
3. Rest the bar at shoulder height in front of you.
4. Press the bar overhead until your arms are fully extended.
5. Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core braced and back against the bench for stability.
2. Drive the bar straight up, not forward.
3. Exhale as you press, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows throughout.

instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and back upright.
2. Hold a barbell with a close overhand grip, hands narrower than shoulder-width.
3. Raise the bar overhead, then lower it behind your head with your elbows bent and pointing up.
4. Extend your elbows to press the bar back overhead until your arms are straight.
5. Lower the bar behind your head again with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows pointing up and close to your head.
2. Move only at the elbows; keep your upper arms still.
3. Control the bar through a full stretch behind your head.
4. Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor.
2. Rest a barbell across your upper back, holding it with a wide overhand grip.
3. Keep your back straight and core braced.
4. Rotate your torso to the right while keeping your hips and legs still.
5. Rotate back through center and twist to the left.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Brace your core to protect your spine.
2. Keep your hips and legs locked in place; only the torso turns.
3. Move smoothly and avoid jerking the bar.
4. Use a light load to keep control through the full range.

instructions:
1. Sit on an exercise ball with your feet flat on the floor.
2. Rest a barbell across your upper back, holding it with a wide overhand grip.
3. Keep your back straight and core braced to stay balanced.
4. Rotate your torso to the right while keeping your hips and legs still.
5. Rotate back through center and twist to the left.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Plant your feet wide for a stable base on the ball.
2. Brace your core to control balance and protect your spine.
3. Keep your hips still; rotate only through the torso.
4. Use a light load and move smoothly.
